tools.name: find_breeding_routes
tools.description: Find breeding routes for a Pal in Palworld: how to breed a target Pal from parent combinations (1-3 steps). Free anonymous tier: 20 calls/day per IP. More calls need an API key (https://ko-fi.com/yugutou/shop) or use the free website https://paltool.cc.

tools.name: get_pal_info
tools.description: Get detailed info about a Pal in Palworld: id, name, element, breed power, work skills, food, egg type. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

tools.name: get_breeding_child
tools.description: Given two parent Pals in Palworld, return the child they produce when bred together. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

tools.name: get_passive
tools.description: Look up a passive skill in Palworld: id, name, description, effects. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

tools.name: search_pals
tools.description: Search Palworld Pals by name, id or element. Returns basic info list. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.
